findings.title: Palestinian Environment Quality Authority warns of vast Gaza hazardous rubble and wastewater contamination
findings.publisher: WAFA (reporting 6 November Environment Quality Authority statement); Anadolu Agency independently reported the statement
findings.location: Gaza Strip (territory-wide estimate; no individual site identified)
findings.affected_population_system: Water and sewage infrastructure (reported 84% destroyed), sanitation and environmental health (reported 120,000 m³/day untreated wastewater), 61–68 million tonnes of demolition rubble including about 4 million tonnes hazardous waste and at least 50,000 tonnes asbestos, farmland and civilians exposed to environmental hazards
findings.exact_supporting_passage: الحرب دمرت 84% من البنية التحتية للمياه والصرف الصحي
findings.source_type: Official Palestinian Environment Quality Authority statement as directly reproduced by WAFA, corroborated by Anadolu; underlying survey methodology not independently checked
findings.confidence: medium-high for statement issuance and attribution; underlying figures unverified independently and could be older cumulative estimates

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_via: Direct Anadolu Middle East publisher page following 2 OCHA/WHO first checks and 12 targeted searches; cross-checked against dated WAFA Arabic article.
bounded_discovery_context.previous_comparison: Nov 6 02:51 PST prior verified heartbeat recorded distinct UNRWA shelter/water assessment but not the Palestinian Environment Quality Authority hazardous rubble/wastewater release. This WAFA 08:42 Gaza-local article predates that heartbeat; it is a newly discovered missed source, not a new incident in this hour.
bounded_discovery_context.attribution_and_timing: Environment Authority statement was published Nov 6 (WAFA local 08:42; 22:42 Nov 5 PST). Assessment/survey period and exact measurement date not given.
bounded_discovery_context.verification_limit: No primary methodology or independent field verification of debris, infrastructure destruction or wastewater estimates. Do not describe figures as newly incurred damage.
bounded_discovery_context.useful_follow_up: Editorial team may compare with historic UNDP/OCHA baseline and obtain the authority's underlying methodology; no publication or approval implied.

findings.title: Anadolu witnesses report Israeli heavy fire reaching displacement tents near Al-Mawasi, northwest of Rafah
findings.location: Al-Mawasi area northwest of Rafah, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced Palestinians sheltering in tents; witnesses said some bullets reached tents; no reported casualties or damage count in this article
findings.exact_supporting_passage: with some bullets reaching tents sheltering displaced Palestinians, according to witnesses.
findings.source_type: Established news agency directly attributing account to witnesses (not independently corroborated)
findings.confidence: medium-low; one named established outlet reports anonymous eyewitnesses; injuries and exact time not independently verified

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_via: Direct Anadolu publisher Middle East index and linked full article after bounded searches, alongside a previously logged casualty follow-up.
bounded_discovery_context.previous_comparison: Sara Abu Jiyab/Nabil Hamad deaths in this article are exact duplicates of prior 00:40 PST heartbeat and excluded; reported separate al-Mawasi gunfire affecting tents was not present in the immediate preceding or 01:44 PST watch notes.
bounded_discovery_context.timing_caveat: Article dated Nov 6 and says Friday; publication time and actual incident hour unknown, so no claim this happened since 02:51 PST. No injury is claimed.
bounded_discovery_context.next_editorial_step: Seek independent PRCS/OCHA or local verification before promotion; keep attributed as witness report.
